say:1:1130117001:1.text: They're very different and are prepared in different ways. Both are delicious, though!
say:1:1130117001:1.source_cn: 区别很大，烹制办法也不同。但同样美味！

say:2:1130117002:1.text: First, there's blazing orchid, which always burns during the day. We must wait until it goes out at night before it can be picked.
say:2:1130117002:1.source_cn: 首先是炽焰兰，它白天一直是燃烧状态，得等夜晚熄灭后才能采摘。

say:3:1130117003:1.text: It's juicy and delicious when mashed with a bit of saltpeter!
say:3:1130117003:1.source_cn: 它的汁水充足，捣烂后加点盐巴就很好吃了！

say:4:1130117004:1.text: As for the sandstone nuts, you can just crack the shells open and eat them! You also have quite a bit of salt left over when you simmer it with other things.
say:4:1130117004:1.source_cn: 至于盐津仁，敲开壳就可以吃！和其他东西炖煮时，能剩下不...
